label: Town of Roxbury
header:
# Town of Roxbury municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 20; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Roxbury, Certificate of Election, Town Officers, March 3, 2026 (attested by Town Clerk Tammy Legacy, March 4, 2026): Jacqueline Frazier was elected Moderator with 161 votes
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk; Roxbury elects its clerk to a one-year term
Town of Roxbury, Certificate of Election, Town Officers, March 3, 2026 (attested by Town Clerk Tammy Legacy, March 4, 2026): Tammy Legacy was elected Town Clerk with 163 votes
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Tammy Legacy as Roxbury's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer; Roxbury elects its treasurer to a one-year term
Town of Roxbury, Certificate of Election, Town Officers, March 3, 2026 (attested by Town Clerk Tammy Legacy, March 4, 2026): Anne Maxham was elected Town Treasurer with 171 votes
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Anne Maxham as Roxbury's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Roxbury's five selectboard members: Jeremy Reed (Chair), Donna French (Vice Chair), Nathan Donahue, Heather Holter, and Timothy Martin

Town of Roxbury, Certificate of Election, Town Officers, March 3, 2026 (attested by Town Clerk Tammy Legacy, March 4, 2026): Heather Holter won the three-year selectboard seat (160 votes) and Timothy Martin the two-year seat (113 votes) at the March 3, 2026 election

offices.title: Lister
offices.org_name: Town of Roxbury Board of Listers

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers of three

Town of Roxbury, Certificate of Election, Town Officers, March 3, 2026 (attested by Town Clerk Tammy Legacy, March 4, 2026): William Hansen won the three-year lister seat (164 votes) and Thomas L. Frazier the two-year remainder (146 votes)
Town of Roxbury, 2024 Annual Report, town officers table (terms with expiry years): Robert Ketchel's lister term runs to 2027
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect auditors (three, staggered terms) unless the office is eliminated

Town of Roxbury, Certificate of Election, Town Officers, March 3, 2026 (attested by Town Clerk Tammy Legacy, March 4, 2026): Karen Tassinari won the two-year auditor seat (153 votes); the three-year and one-year auditor seats both returned 'No one received enough votes', so one of Roxbury's three auditor seats stands vacant
Town of Roxbury, 2024 Annual Report, town officers table (terms with expiry years): Jillian Abraham (Chair) holds an auditor term to 2027

offices.title: Collector of Delinquent Taxes
offices.org_name: Town of Roxbury Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a collector of delinquent taxes for a one-year term unless the town votes a longer term
Town of Roxbury, Certificate of Election, Town Officers, March 3, 2026 (attested by Town Clerk Tammy Legacy, March 4, 2026): William Hansen was elected Collector of Delinquent Taxes with 166 votes
Town of Roxbury, Certificate of Election, Town Officers, March 3, 2026 (attested by Town Clerk Tammy Legacy, March 4, 2026): William Cecil won the three-year cemetery commissioner seat (166 votes)

Town of Roxbury, 2024 Annual Report, town officers table (terms with expiry years): Wendy Cashman's cemetery commissioner term runs to 2027. The third seat, whose term stood in 2025, has no published outcome, so it is left unfilled
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a first constable
Town of Roxbury, Certificate of Election, Town Officers, March 3, 2026 (attested by Town Clerk Tammy Legacy, March 4, 2026): William Hansen was elected First Constable with 164 votes
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns may elect a second constable
Town of Roxbury, Certificate of Election, Town Officers, March 3, 2026 (attested by Town Clerk Tammy Legacy, March 4, 2026): Andrew Apgar was elected Second Constable with 156 votes

Town of Roxbury, Certificate of Election, Town Officers, March 3, 2026 (attested by Town Clerk Tammy Legacy, March 4, 2026): Heidi Albright was re-elected a library trustee (165 votes); the other two 2026 trustee seats returned 'No one received enough votes'

Town of Roxbury, 2024 Annual Report, town officers table (terms with expiry years): Carl Ellis's library trustee term runs to 2027. A third seat filled in 2025 has no published holder, so three of the five seats are left unfilled
